privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: This policy explains how WFChat handles data when you use Chat, Google Login, Sync, voice features, and Aiko Cafe. It applies whether you continue as a Guest or sign in.
privacy.google.title: Google Login
privacy.google.optional: Google Login is optional. You can use WFChat as a Guest without signing in.
privacy.google.received: When you choose Google Login, WFChat receives your Google account's stable identifier, email address, name, and profile picture URL.
privacy.google.purpose: WFChat uses this data to create or find your account, show your profile, keep your data under the correct owner, and support Sync across your sessions.
privacy.google.notReceived: WFChat does not receive your Google password or access to your Gmail or Google Drive.
privacy.google.token: The Google ID token is used to verify the sign-in with Google and is not saved as part of your account data.
privacy.data.title: Data WFChat keeps
privacy.data.session: Session and account data: an essential session cookie that browser JavaScript cannot read, server session state, and—after Google Login—your identity and editable profile.
privacy.data.chat: Chat data: chat rooms, messages, image attachments, and selected learned context derived from conversations to keep later chats consistent.
privacy.data.sync: Sync data: selected settings such as theme, font, language, and background image URL, plus supported chat summaries and cached messages.
privacy.data.cafe: Aiko Cafe data: stars, unlocked items, equipped appearance, and reward records. A temporary Cafe name stays in the current browser tab.
privacy.data.operations: Service data: daily quota counters and limited technical, security, and cleanup logs used to operate and protect the service.
privacy.processing.title: AI, voice, and external services
privacy.processing.chat: To generate a reply, WFChat may send the character instructions, relevant learned context, current chat history, your latest message, and supported attachments to the AI provider configured by the service. Provider processing follows that provider's own service and privacy terms.
privacy.processing.images: Uploaded images are validated and stored as their original PNG, JPEG, or WebP bytes. WFChat does not remove embedded image metadata before storage or supported AI processing.
privacy.processing.voice: Voice features run only when you choose them. A configured speech provider may receive assistant text, and a configured transcription provider may receive your recorded audio. Transcription audio is not persisted or logged by WFChat.
privacy.processing.external: When loaded, Google Login, hosted fonts, and externally hosted profile or background images can contact their respective hosts. Those hosts may receive ordinary web request data such as your IP address and browser information.
privacy.retention.title: How long data stays
privacy.retention.account: Account, profile, chat, attachment, learned-context, Sync, and Cafe persistence stays until you delete the relevant content or permanently delete the account. WFChat does not set one automatic expiry for all of these categories.
privacy.retention.guest: Guest data is tied to an expiring server session and may be removed after that session expires or is revoked.
privacy.retention.cafe: Cafe room chat, presence, and room state are temporary and are removed with the room; they are not written to the account database or learned context.
privacy.retention.voice: Transcription audio is not retained. Successfully generated speech audio is cached only for the current browser session.
privacy.retention.logs: WFChat writes limited logs to the runtime output. Access logs include request metadata such as time, route, status, duration, request ID, and resolved IP, but not chat text, files, cookies, tokens, or request and response bodies. The app itself does not set log rotation or a retention period; retention depends on the environment running it.
privacy.deletion.title: Permanent account deletion
privacy.deletion.immediate: You can permanently delete a signed-in account from Profile. The action is immediate, cannot be undone, and returns the browser to a new Guest. A later Google Login creates a new account; the deleted data does not return.
privacy.deletion.server: The deletion removes the Google identity, editable profile, registered sessions, chats, attachment records, learned context, Sync data, and saved Cafe progress.
privacy.deletion.browser: The browser clears account-derived chat and Sync caches, pending Sync work, and the synced background image. Device theme, font, and language stay unchanged.
privacy.deletion.files: Attachment access ends immediately. If a stored file cannot be removed at that moment, a durable cleanup task keeps retrying on the server and requires no action from you.
privacy.quota.title: Quota after account deletion
privacy.quota.account: Deleting and signing up again does not reset the current day's account chat allowance. Until the next midnight in Asia/Bangkok, the replacement Guest carries only an internal pseudonymous account quota identifier and that day's counter—not your Google profile. Eligible past quota records are removed in bounded cleanup runs after the date changes.
privacy.quota.global: WFChat also keeps a separate daily aggregate quota for the service as a whole. It limits total AI generations across all users and does not identify one user's Google account.
privacy.controls.title: Your controls
privacy.controls.description: You can edit your profile, delete chats, clear chat messages, reset learned context without deleting chat history, remove pending attachments, change device settings, log out, or permanently delete your account through the available WFChat controls.

privacy.contact.description: For privacy questions or account-deletion help, contact:
